functions.comment: Returns 42 from the shared Go engine. This is the only operation in the initial runnable Core contract. It is synchronous, thread-safe, and requires no platform capability. It returns a scalar without transferring resources; runtime initialization is separate. There are no input pointers, owned objects, callbacks, or error conditions. Binding pattern: scalar-unary. Ownership: returns a value; no resources are transferred. Threading: safe for concurrent calls. Availability: 0.0.1.
